name: Mobility_2
display_help: Every character is assigned a Mobility score, and it determines how many stacks of Mobility you can passively accumulate. Each stack of Mobility grants you resistance to travel suppression, resistance to slows, and a small amount of Recharge. Through other powers and abilities, any character may accumulate up to nine stacks of Mobility, but the stacks will gradually decay down to your base rating.
